shellCommands.command: grep -rn "use cache: private" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server --include=*.js -l | head; grep -rn "runtimePrefetch\|runtime prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js -l | head

grep -rn "runtime" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/scheduler.js | head -20; grep -rn "fetchRuntime\|dynamicRequest\|fetchDynamic" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/*.js | grep -v map | head

curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D' | head -c 3000; echo; echo "=== HTTP headers ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D'

curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D' > /tmp/prefetch-sale.txt; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/prefetch-sale.txt; grep -o "Products on sale" /tmp/prefetch-sale.txt | head -2; grep -o "Loading category" /tmp/prefetch-sale.txt | head -2; wc -c /tmp/prefetch-sale.txt

curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=featured" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D' > /tmp/prefetch-featured.txt; grep -o "Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Canvas Tote\|Featured products" /tmp/prefetch-featured.txt | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== warm-cache prefetch timing (sale) ==="; time curl -sL -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D'; echo "=== plain page still works ==="; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Canvas Tote\|Loading category" | head
git -C /workspace diff --stat; git -C /workspace diff -- app lib
